name: Nanjing Leads Biolabs Co., Ltd.
summary: Nanjing Leads Biolabs Co., Ltd., a clinical-stage biotechnology company, engages in the research, development, and commercialization of novel antibody drugs worldwide. It develops therapies in oncology, autoimmune, and other severe diseases. The company's lead product LBL-024, a PD-L1/4-1BB bispecific antibody for extra-pulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma; LBL-007, a novel anti-LAG-3 antibody designed to restore T-cell activity; LBL-034, a novel GPRC5D-targeting T-cell engager for anti-tumor activity.
